host.backend_inventory:
cpu (reference) — the reference transport on host threads; IEEE-754 double, bitwise reproducible
  integrators: path, light, hybrid
  [0] 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12650H — cpu, 16 hardware threads
gpu — portable GPU: Vulkan compute with Slang kernels (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel; Apple silicon via MoltenVK); float32, camera-relative
  integrators: path, light, hybrid, sppm, bdpt, vcm
  [0] Intel(R) Graphics (ADL GT2) — integrated, Vulkan 1.4.354
  [1] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU — discrete, Vulkan 1.4.351, ray queries
